+/-! ## Protocol conformance inference -/
+
+/-- Infer protocol conformances for emitted types from typeclass instances. -/
+private def collectConformances (localDecls : Array (Decl .pure))
+    (emittedTypes : Array Name) : TranslateM (Array SwiftDecl) := do
+  let env ← getEnv
+  let mut result : Array SwiftDecl := #[]
+  let mut seen : Array (Name × Name) := #[]  -- (typeName, className) dedup
+  for decl in localDecls do
+    if !isInstanceDecl decl.name then continue
+    -- Extract class name and concrete type from instance type
+    let (className, concreteTypeName) := match decl.type with
+      | .app (.const cn _) (.const tn _) => (cn, tn)
+      | .const cn _ => (cn, Name.anonymous)
+      | _ => (Name.anonymous, Name.anonymous)
+    if !isSafeClass className then continue
+    if concreteTypeName == Name.anonymous then continue
+    -- Only generate conformances for types we actually emit
+    if !emittedTypes.contains concreteTypeName then continue
+    -- Deduplicate
+    if seen.contains (concreteTypeName, className) then continue
+    seen := seen.push (concreteTypeName, className)
+    -- Build witness map from constructor fields
+    let mut witnessMap : Array (Name × Name) := #[]
+    if let some (.inductInfo ival) := env.find? className then
+      if let some ctorName := ival.ctors[0]? then
+        if let some (.ctorInfo cval) := env.find? ctorName then
+          let mut cur := cval.type
+          let mut skipCount := cval.numParams
+          while true do
+            match cur with
+            | .forallE fname _ cbody _ =>
+              if skipCount > 0 then
+                skipCount := skipCount - 1
+                cur := cbody.instantiate1 (mkConst ``lcErased)
+              else
+                witnessMap := witnessMap.push (fname, concreteTypeName ++ fname)
+                cur := cbody.instantiate1 (mkConst ``lcErased)
+            | _ => break
+    result := result.push (.conformance concreteTypeName #[]
+      (swiftProtocolName className) witnessMap)
+  return result
+
